name: 38901 · Grenada, MS
findings: ZIP 38901 (Grenada) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38901 (Grenada) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38901 (Grenada) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
